He has top-10 performances at Augusta National in two of the past three years, finishing T-7 in 2023 and T-9 in 2024. Earlier this year, he won the Players Championship and finished T-3 in the Arnold Palmer Invitational and T-7 in Los Angeles. In 2025, he earned his first career PGA Tour win in Greensboro, finished T-4 in the Canadian Open, U.S. Open and Tour Championship and represented the United States in his first Ryder Cup. Before earning his first PGA Tour win, he had finished inside the top three nine times, including runner-up in The Open and T-3 in the PGA Championship in 2022.
